items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: John was playing with Dizzy’s band at the time, John Lewis was.

ctx.x: Yeah, a sweetheart. So I was out there. Dizzy lived close by. John was playing with Dizzy’s band at the time, John Lewis was. He’d come home after a gig and run his head into the wall, right into the wall. He was so . . .
